rotation: Given the high severity of persistent inflation and monetary policy uncertainty, sectors with inflation-hedging potential, such as energy and commodities, are favored. Conversely, technology and consumer discretionary sectors, which may face higher borrowing costs, are pressured. The stabilization of the labor market amid shifting dynamics supports sectors reliant on labor, such as healthcare and education, while pressuring those in retail and hospitality.
